The girl set out from the coast one afternoon
and was caught in a storm. Her boat struck a
rock, so she jumped into the sea. She swam
eight miles that night. She reached the shore
early next morning. She had seen a light high
up on the cliffs and she climbed up. She found
herself in hospital a day later.
